$comment: HAND-EDITED source of the hover card settings (cx-23e1f); gen-settings-sources.py writes the Swift descriptors and parser constants. Row fields: see schemas/settings/source/updates.json.

lists.name: hoverCards
lists.note: Hover cards of sidebar workspace rows and tabs (Lawrence 2026-10-14: can be turned off; 2026-10-18: Chrome's 1300 ms was too slow, about a tooltip's delay now).

rows.note: On by default. Off: no card opens on hover; Show Resource Usage still opens one.

help.text: A card with details opens when the pointer rests on a workspace or a tab.

rows.note: Milliseconds the pointer rests before the first card opens (HoverCardTiming.showDelay). While a card shows, or within 500 ms after it went, the next one opens at once.

help.text: How long the pointer rests on a workspace or a tab before its card opens. While a card shows, the next one opens at once.
